svg.title: YakKeeper public collaboration platform architecture
svg.desc: GitHub OAuth through Supabase verifies account identity. Public repository metadata is read from GitHub without write scopes. Next.js checks ownership before using a server key to access Supabase Postgres. The loopback-only sandbox uses a separate local SQLite store and explicitly unverified demo sessions. WhatsApp is optional for administrator projects.
svg.text: Where projects meet their next contributors.
Public collaboration platform · recommended production deployment
No code writes or repository access grants
RLS · server checks · expiring image links
LOCAL SANDBOX ONLY · ALTERNATIVE DATA PATH
Local testing only · unverified accounts · never deploy the SQLite data file
After saving requests to admin projects
Sign in through GitHub → Supabase callback
No repository write scopes. No private repository import. No invitation gate for public GitHub-connected publishers.
Implementation diagram. Real OAuth needs provider credentials and the server key. Sandbox sessions are never GitHub verified.
